text:
Kai Morgan: Need a small "launch asset handbook" for the upcoming benchmark webinar. Deliverables: hero banner (1600x420), condensed hero (1200x628), email header (600x200), three social crops, a 1-slide inbound-routing diagram (SVG + 600x360 PNG), and a one-pager PDF "asset manifest" with filenames, alt text, and export specs. Deadline: next Tue 2pm PT.

Lina Torres: On it. Quick Qs: do we need animated versions or keep everything static? Also, should the diagram include explicit routing labels (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and optional stat callouts?

Kai Morgan: Animated hero optional but provide GIF/Lottie fallback if animated. Diagram yes: label nodes Hosted/Dedicated/Private and add toggleable stat callouts (ms and $/1k tokens) as an optional SVG layer. Sales wants the arrows annotated: "latency" and "unit cost".

Hiro Tanaka: Brand constraints: palette v3 tokens only, no bright magenta. Fonts: Inter Display for headings, Inter for body. Body text contrast >= 4.5:1. Provide alt text and reduced-motion static assets.

DesignOps Bot: Design slot requested for Hiro Mon 9am PT. If team needs rush, request priority. I'll auto-generate a checklist: hero, condensed hero, email header, 3 social crops, routing SVG+PNG, manifest JSON, alt-text doc.

Lina Torres: Copy note: I'll draft 3 hooks + 2 CTAs. Tone: straightforward, utility-first. Suggestions: "Benchmark: latency vs cost" / "Inference economics that scale". Will paste exact copy in the Figma file.

SalesOps Bot: Sales ask: make the routing SVG modular so reps can hide/show Hosted/Dedicated/Private nodes and toggle stats. Also include a PDF slide export sized 1280x720.

Kai Morgan: Naming convention: asset-channel-size-v1.ext (e.g., hero-web-1600x420-v1.png). Manifest should include source Figma link, export sizes, and alt text fields.

Lina Torres: I'll add alt text drafts like: "Webinar hero: stylized stack graphic with headline 'Inference economics that scale' and CTA 'Register'". Will include short and long alt versions.

Hiro Tanaka: For animated hero: max 6s loop, avoid rapid flashes, provide motion-safe PNG. Dark-mode variants required. Contrast check will run post-Figma.

DesignOps Bot: Reminder scheduled Tue 10am PT to check exports and assign Brand Review. Please attach the Figma link in this thread when ready.

Lina Torres: ETA first comps: Mon 3pm PT. Will include Figma link and manifest JSON in file comments.

Kai Morgan: Thanks team. Priority is clarity for inbound routing + sales reusability. If tradeoffs on motion vs accessibility, flag them in Figma. Locking deadline Tue 2pm PT unless we escalate. :rocket:
